Flamingo Tech Sol • Portfolio Concept

Vreehi Restaurant — Case Study

We used Vreehi's public website information as the brief for a fictional redesign concept: make the restaurant's regional identity immediately visible, reduce the distance between discovery and booking, and make the menu easier to explore on mobile.

Business storyOdia and Bengali flavours alongside Indian, Tandoori, Chinese and Continental options.
Primary actionsView the menu, book a table, contact the restaurant and start a WhatsApp enquiry.
Content strategyLead with signature cuisine, chef specials, thalis, reviews, gallery and location trust signals.
Local conversionKeep Lalpur, Ranchi, contact details and business information prominent throughout the journey.

Reference business information: Vreehi Restaurant, 2nd Floor, Sri Ram Neotia Arcade near Lalpur Chowk, Ranchi. This is a concept presentation, not a claim of client relationship.

Flamingo Tech Sol • Portfolio Concept

Glow & Shine Unisex Salon — Case Study

We treated the public listing as a local-business website brief: make the salon's services immediately understandable, create a premium visual first impression, and make appointment enquiries the primary conversion.

Business profileUnisex salon in Diwakar Nagar, Ranchi, near Hariom Mediciner and Hotel D.N. Grand.
Services to surfaceHair styling, hair cuts, hair colour, plus broader hair care, skin care, nails, hair removal and makeup categories listed on the business profile.
Conversion strategyPrimary Book Appointment CTA, quick service discovery, WhatsApp/call enquiry and a clear location section.
Local growthBuild around local search intent, service pages, Google Business Profile support, reviews, offers and before/after content.

Reference: the supplied Justdial listing identifies Glow & Shine Unisex Salon in Diwakar Nagar, Ranchi. Justdial lists 4.7/5 from 9 ratings and hours of 8:30 AM–9:00 PM; business information can change, so verify details with the salon before publishing them. This is a concept presentation, not a claim of client relationship.

Aarohan Learning Studio — Case Study

This fictional education concept explores how a learning business can communicate its programs and learner outcomes clearly while giving prospective students a simple path to enquire.

Visual directionForest green, warm ivory and saffron accents create a calm, confident identity distinct from the blue agency brand.

Conversion strategyClear program discovery and repeated enquiry actions without overwhelming the visitor.
SEO foundationSemantic headings, descriptive page metadata, responsive layout and content structured around learning intent.
